story.text: 승객 여러분, 이번엔 웃음과 신명이 가득한 마당으로 안내해 드릴게요. 우리 조상들의 해학을 만나보세요.
story.reading: seung-gaek yeo-reo-bun, i-beon-en us-eum-gwa sin-myeong-i ga-deuk-han ma-dang-eu-ro an-nae-hae deu-ril-ge-yo. u-ri jo-sang-deul-ui hae-hag-eul man-na-bo-se-yo.
story.en: Passengers, this time let me guide you to a yard full of laughter and excitement. Come meet the wit of our ancestors.

story.text: 옛사람들은 나무나 바가지로 얼굴 가면, '탈'을 만들었어요. 탈을 쓰면 신분과 상관없이 누구든 마음껏 말할 수 있었지요.
story.reading: yet-sa-ram-deul-eun na-mu-na ba-ga-ji-ro eol-gul ga-myeon, tal-eul man-deul-eo-sseo-yo. tal-eul sseu-myeon sin-bun-gwa sang-gwan-eob-si nu-gu-deun ma-eum-kkeot mal-hal su it-seot-ji-yo.
story.en: People long ago made face masks, called 'tal', from wood or gourds. Wearing a mask, anyone could speak freely regardless of social status.

story.text: 이 탈을 쓰고 추는 춤이 바로 '탈춤'이에요. 노래와 춤, 재치 있는 이야기가 어우러진 우리 전통 공연이랍니다.
story.reading: i tal-eul sseu-go chu-neun chum-i ba-ro tal-chum-i-e-yo. no-rae-wa chum, jae-chi it-neun i-ya-gi-ga eo-u-reo-jin u-ri jeon-tong gong-yeon-i-ram-ni-da.
story.en: The dance performed while wearing this mask is 'talchum' (mask dance). It's our traditional performance combining song, dance, and witty storytelling.

story.text: 탈춤에서 자주 놀림받는 인물이 바로 '양반'이에요. 백성들은 탈춤을 통해 신분 높은 양반을 재치 있게 풍자했답니다.
story.reading: tal-chum-e-seo ja-ju nol-lim-bad-neun in-mul-i ba-ro yang-ban-i-e-yo. baek-seong-deul-eun tal-chum-eul tong-hae sin-bun nop-eun yang-ban-eul jae-chi it-ge pung-ja-haet-dam-ni-da.
story.en: A character often mocked in mask dance is the 'yangban' (noble). Through mask dance, commoners wittily satirized the high-status yangban.

story.text: 신나는 춤에는 흥겨운 '장단'이 빠질 수 없어요. 장구와 꽹과리 소리에 맞춰 어깨가 절로 들썩인답니다.
story.reading: sin-na-neun chum-e-neun heung-gyeo-un jang-dan-i ppa-jil su eob-seo-yo. jang-gu-wa kkwaeng-gwa-ri so-ri-e maj-chwo eo-kkae-ga jeol-lo deul-sseog-in-dam-ni-da.
story.en: A lively 'rhythm' can't be missing from an exciting dance. Following the sound of the janggu and kkwaenggwari, shoulders naturally start to move.

story.text: 이런 놀이는 마을 '마당놀이'로 이어졌어요. 신분에 상관없이 온 마을 사람들이 함께 어울려 즐기는 축제였지요.
story.reading: i-reon nol-i-neun ma-eul ma-dang-nol-i-ro i-eo-jyeo-sseo-yo. sin-bun-e sang-gwan-eob-si on ma-eul sa-ram-deul-i ham-kke eo-ul-lyeo jeul-gi-neun chuk-je-yeot-ji-yo.
story.en: This kind of play carried on into the village's 'madangnori' (outdoor folk play). It was a festival where the whole village enjoyed themselves together, regardless of status.

story.text: 자, 웃음과 흥이 넘치는 다섯 단어를 배웠어요. 이제 신명 나게 문제를 풀어볼까요!
story.reading: ja, us-eum-gwa heung-i neom-chi-neun da-seot dan-eo-reul bae-wo-sseo-yo. i-je sin-myeong na-ge mun-je-reul pul-eo-bol-kka-yo!
story.en: Now, you've learned five words overflowing with laughter and excitement. Let's solve some questions with high spirits!

words.example_en: Mask dance is a dance performed while wearing a mask.
Masks are made of wood or paper.
Madangnori is a performance held in a yard.
In mask dance, the yangban is sometimes mocked.
You dance in time with the rhythm.

sentences.en: Mask dance holds the wit of our ancestors.

sentences.ko: 탈을 쓰면 다른 사람이 된 듯해요.
sentences.reading: tal-eul sseu-myeon da-reun sa-ram-i doen deut-hae-yo
sentences.en: Wearing a mask feels like becoming someone else.
The yangban becomes a laughingstock in mask dance.
As the rhythm speeds up, the dance gets more lively.
